snippet.title: WildTangent Super Granny Gameplay
snippet.description: This game is about an elderly lady saving a bunch of cats. There are several games produced in this series, but I will make gameplay videos of the sequels sometime later. I remember playing this WildTangent game on my Dad's Compaq PC back in 2006, but I can't remember what model it was.
